name: Nissan Shatai Co., Ltd.
summary: Nissan Shatai Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells vehicles in Japan. It operates through Automotive-Related; Equipment Maintenance; Information Processing; and Temporary Staffing segments. The company offers passenger and commercial vehicles, minibuses, and vehicle parts, as well as premium and specially equipped vehicles. It also provides logistics services; provides engineering services, creates prototypes, and manufactures molds and jigs; system and program development services; and IT and system maintenance, temporary staffing, and equipment maintenance services.
